items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Johnny and I left the band and we were joined by Al Sears in New York.

ctx.x: When you left, with Johnny and -- you and Johnny and who else left at the same time?
Johnny and I left the band and we were joined by Al Sears in New York. And we had the nucleus of a very nice little group.
But you get those pressures from high up when you go to the job -- well, I'm sorry I can't take you. And --
